Done. Summary of the data-lead work on `feat/backend-data`:

**Shared vocabulary (`shared/src/vocabulary.ts`, new)** — the prototype's skills (8 instruments + 3 studio), 8 genres, 5 moods, and all 24 keys (12 notes × major/minor, ♯/♭ spellings as in the prototype), as `as const` runtime lists plus derived types. The file is a deliberate leaf (no imports) so the package keeps its no-build-step nature: the new `./vocabulary` exports subpath is loadable by tsx, vitest, Vite, and the compiled server on Node 24 via native type stripping (workspace symlink resolves outside `node_modules`). The package root `.` stays types-only, so the existing contract is mechanically preserved.

**Models (`server/src/models/`, new)** — `Project` (owner, title, description, optional BPM/key/genre/mood tags validated against the vocabulary, required non-empty `needs`, open/closed status, `currentVersion`, feed index `{status: 1, updatedAt: -1}`) and `Contribution` (one document per project version, v1 = the owner's original track, unique `{project, version}` index so concurrent submissions can't create two v2s, optional link to a Recording, note). Both serialize to the new `ProjectDto`/`ContributionDto` shapes in `shared/src/projects.ts`.

**Wired into the app** — `User` gains a vocabulary-validated `skills` array (default `[]`), `PublicUser`/`SignUpRequest` carry it, and the signup route accepts and stores chosen skills; `auth.test.ts`'s one exact-shape assertion was updated for the new field. Seeding reuses the app's own `loadConfig`/`connectDb`.

**Seed data (`server/src/models/seed.ts`, new)** — the prototype's demo content: 12 users, 7 projects, 11 version-history rows, with the prototype's relative times as real timestamps so the feed sorts by activity. Idempotent (only ever removes its own demo users). `npm run seed` uses `MONGODB_URI`; `npm run seed -- --in-memory` needs no MongoDB at all (mongodb-memory-server), which is how it runs on this machine.

**Tests (`server/test/models.test.ts`, new)** — vocabulary sanity, project/contribution validation, user skills, signup-with-skills through the real route, and the seed (counts, histories, exact timestamps, feed order, idempotency). 25 new tests; 107 server + 78 client all pass, lint/typecheck/build green. Note: `npm test` exits 1 solely from 5 pre-existing unhandled MongoClientClosedError teardown rejections in `app.test.ts` — verified identical on the clean tree via git stash.

Verified end-to-end both ways: `npm run seed -- --in-memory` (tsx) and `node dist/models/seed.js --in-memory` (compiled, proving the Node 24 type-stripping path Render will use).

Left for the routes lead: `/api/projects` + feed + contributions endpoints (the DTOs and `toProjectDto`/`toContributionDto` helpers are ready); for the client leads: skill picker and project screens (vocabulary importable from `@exquisite-chorus/shared/vocabulary`).
